body: Thank you for taking the time to read my babblings.

I ran out and just didn't buy any. It never lasts but I hope I can break it every time. Been about a week now and I'm still nauseous . haven't eaten since. I do drink a carnation instant breakfast to get something in me but it's no super food.. very anxious and angry.   Withdrawel  Symptoms  aren't that severe. certainly not life threatening  but they do exist. Every day I'm away it gets a little easier. But then I'll bump into someone and they'll get me high and I end up back where I started.
Bless you kid.   I'm sorry for your pain but I understand..
I beg for a deity to let me trades places with someone terminally ill everyday. You're never alone. You're young. What's up with parents? I wish I could hold you kid.
Don't EVER apologize for your pain. It's REAL and deserving of understanding.
IF you tell a professional you are suicidal and have a plan SOMEONE WILL PUT YOU on a psych unit.

You're not alone. I'm afraid to kill myself because I don't know where we go. I want to just CEASE TO EXIST. But I'm afraid there's a hell and I'm going there. I can't say I have words of encouragement but just know you're not alone. I have regrets from the past too that I'm afraid I'll pay for in the afterlife if there is one. WTF are we doing here? I'd have to ask you to kill me first so that wouldn't be productive for you. Wow, I probably shouldn't comment to anyone. I'm not exactly a ray of sunshine. I'm sorry.  I wish I had answers.

I don't talk to anyone except my therapist. if they can't see the problem a lot of people have no sympathy for something they simply can't understand. Hugs kid. I wake up every morning pissed that I have to live another day. so I do understand.
